messages:
Sasha: ran a precision scan across H100/A100 in us/eu/apac for marlin70b variants. uploading quick notes + charts: https://redwood.internal/bench/2471001234 (csv attached). precisions tested: fp16, bf16, fp8, int8. looking for latency/throughput + quality deltas.
bench-bot: Auto-run finished for 2471001234. Summary: H100 FP8 ~1.9x token throughput vs FP16; H100 INT8 ~2.3x but PPL +2.8% on longform. A100 FP8 ~1.4x vs FP16. CSV: s3://redwood-bench/2471001234.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Priya: nice — can you paste p50/p95 latency numbers per GPU?
Sasha: here are the p50/p95 (ms) snapshots I pulled from the run: ```
H100 FP16:  p50=8   p95=18
H100 FP8:   p50=6   p95=14
H100 INT8:  p50=5   p95=13
A100 FP16:  p50=11  p95=26
A100 FP8:   p50=9   p95=22
A100 INT8:  p50=8   p95=20
```
Liam: what quality metric did you use? ppl on a heldout longform set or QA?
Sasha: used two evals: 5k QA pairs (F1/EM) and a 10k longform PPL sample. quick deltas vs H100 FP16 baseline: 
- H100 FP8: PPL +0.6%, QA F1 -0.4%
- H100 INT8: PPL +2.8%, QA F1 -1.9%
- A100 FP8: PPL +1.1%, QA F1 -0.9%
- A100 INT8: PPL +3.2%, QA F1 -2.1%
Mateo: any kernel differences or unexpected fallbacks we should note?
Sasha: yes — H100 used fused attention kernel v2 + matmul-epic path for fp8, gave the best perf. A100 int8 fell back to legacy GEMM + split-k path for some layers (we saw ~8% extra overhead). kernel map and ops-per-layer in the csv.
Priya: capacity sizing question — tokens/sec per GPU assuming ctx=128, microbatch=4, continuous batching on?
Sasha: tokens/sec (approx, warm cache): ```
H100 FP16:  18k t/s
H100 FP8:   34k t/s
H100 INT8:  41k t/s
A100 FP16:  12k t/s
A100 FP8:   17k t/s
A100 INT8:  20k t/s
```
bench-bot: Note: runs had continuous batching enabled, prefix KV cache warm, and 2 warmup iterations. config snippet used: ```make bench MODEL=marlin70b GPUS=h100,a100 PRECISIONS="fp16,bf16,fp8,int8" CONT_Batching=1 MICROBATCH=4 CTX=128```
Liam: my take: FP8 on H100 looks safe for canary (small quality delta, big speedup). INT8 shows meaningful quality regression — use for throughput-only non-critical backfills or aggressive cost tiers only. recommend canary rollout H100->us-west first.
Priya: I'll create a canary job in Dedicated pool us-west2 and pin to fused kernel. @Sasha can you open PR to update model config with fp8 qprofile + fallback policy?
Sasha: on it — opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482 :thumbsup: 
Liam: also add a perf dashboard widget (p50/p95 + QA delta) for the rollout so we can auto-roll back if F1 drops >1%.
Sasha: added dashboard task to the PR description. will attach the final csv and screenshots once PR merges.
